welcomeDetailed:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original Fattoush character art exploration for Ismi, an adult language-learning app. This is generated concept art, not a claim of human illustration.
Create ONE polished square portrait illustration, no text, on a plain warm ivory #FAF7EF background. A memorable friendly adult Palestinian woman, dark almost-black shoulder-length wavy/curly hair built from 7–9 big intentional locks, one distinctive off-center curl over her forehead and a wider curl on one side. Warm medium olive-brown skin. Strong expressive dark eyebrows, clearly separated large almond/oval eyes with white sclera and dark pupils, substantial simple nose with a rounded hooked end, a soft angular adult face, small gold stud earrings. Rich deep green casual overshirt with open collar over a light cream top; no costume or ethnic shorthand.
Style: deliberately composed flat 2D cartoon cel artwork, bold simple color masses, confident clean dark warm charcoal outlines, slightly irregular lively contour, no gradients, NO airbrush, no 3D, no shiny skin, no texture noise, no generic corporate blob anatomy. Clear economical shapes and appealing silhouette, character-specific facial construction. Adult proportions with head only modestly enlarged for mobile readability, defined neck and shoulders, adult not child. Original identity; do not copy any existing franchise character. Palette rich green #08734E, charcoal #292522, skin warm olive #BD805B, restrained red #B83F32 and gold #D9A42D.
STATE: WELCOMING. Eyes meet viewer, eyebrows gently lifted and open, head nearly upright with slight friendly turn, small relaxed open mouth smile with just a little upper tooth visible, shoulders open, one simple raised hand held near chest palm toward viewer in a modest hello. Smile warm and contained, not a giant grin. Eyebrows, eyes, head and shoulders must all support a warm greeting. Crop from middle torso upward, entire hair and hand comfortably inside frame; face occupies about 40 percent of total image height so it reads at 64px. No decorative stars, badges, hearts, confetti, props, borders, lettering or watermark. High craft, elegant controlled cartoon shape design.
welcomeGraphic:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square portrait, no words. Original flat cartoon character Fattoush for an adult language-learning app. ART DIRECTION RESET: use very simplified boldly designed 2D shapes, no realistic drawing. Think charming print-cutout character animation with subtle hand-drawn contour character. The head is an elongated rounded trapezoid with a broad simple nose, small chin, a long adult neck, shoulders in a relaxed green overshirt over cream T-shirt. Warm terracotta/olive skin is ONE solid color #BD805B with NO shading or highlights. Black-brown wavy hair is ONE solid graphic mass with exactly 6 big rounded scallops around the outer silhouette, ONE large swooping curl over forehead and two small interior dark lines at most. Gold small stud earring. Adult woman, recognizably grown up, head-to-shoulder proportions not babyish.
The face uses TWO clean white oval eyes with big solid black pupils (NO highlights), TWO chunky tapered dark eyebrow shapes, an expressive simple hooked nose in 2 strokes, and a simple small smiling mouth with a single cream tooth shape. NO lip outlines, NO lipstick, NO eyeliner, NO eyelashes, NO blush, NO skin rendering, NO hair strands, NO glossy details. Mouth is modest rather than a grin. Each shape must read crisply when the ENTIRE picture is only 64px wide. 6 main colors plus background, hard edges, no gradients, no 3D, no textured paper, no Disney/anime style. Outline is spare warm charcoal, not uniform enclosing every color plane.
EXPRESSION: WELCOMING. Friendly direct eye contact with viewer, both eyebrows slightly lifted, head near upright with small sideways inclination, modest open smile with a little upper tooth, shoulders open at unequal relaxed heights. One hand raised beside chest in a small relaxed hello with fingers together, not a massive foreground hand. Dark curly shoulder-length hair and rich green clothing are key identity anchors. Face approximately 43% of canvas height; head/hair entirely in frame with ample cream margin, portrait cropped at lower chest. Background entirely flat #FAF7EF. Rich forest green #08734E, rich muted red #B83F32 only in small mouth accent, gold #D9A42D stud, charcoal #292522, skin #BD805B. Original appealing silhouette and confident intentional simple shape language. No stars, badges, symbols, text, logos or other graphics.
listening:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied Fattoush graphic portrait into ONE new ATTENTIVELY LISTENING portrait. Reference image is the simpler graphic version with solid broad black-brown wavy hair, cream background, large plain white eyes and green open overshirt. Preserve exactly this character identity and the illustration language: same adult face proportions, long nose, same side-parted big curl and scalloped shoulder-length hair silhouette, warm olive/terracotta skin, gold stud earrings, deep green collared overshirt and cream T shirt, flat graphic shapes and spare charcoal contour. No new facial detailing, no makeup or extra highlights.
CHANGE the emotional acting as a coordinated pose:
- Turn the head about 15 degrees toward viewer's right and incline the head about 12 degrees toward the offscreen speaker on that side.
- Both pupils clearly look toward the offscreen speaker on viewer's right; eyes open with focused, relaxed upper lids, NO staring astonishment.
- One eyebrow gently raised in interest, the other relaxed nearly horizontal; no frown or worried inner-brow peak.
- Mouth CLOSED, a small nearly level relaxed line with one slightly upturned corner, no teeth, not speaking and not grinning.
- Slight forward lean from the upper back, shoulders subtly turned toward speaker. Remove the waving hand completely; hands below the portrait crop.
Keep the same lower-chest square framing, comparable face scale as reference, entire hair within frame with cream margins. Plain warm ivory background. No props, text, icons, hand by the ear, nod motion marks, dramatic reaction or symbols. Readable and unmistakably listening at 64px, adult warm calm attention.
encouraging:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE new square Fattoush portrait by editing the supplied welcoming portrait. Keep EXACT same adult woman identity, same simplified large white oval eyes and solid charcoal pupils, same long simple hooked nose and adult facial proportions, dark broad wavy shoulder-length hair with the same side-part and big front curl, gold stud earrings, warm olive/terracotta skin, green collared overshirt over cream top, plain ivory background, flat cartoon shape language and few clean contours. Match palette and framing faithfully.
NEW STATE: GENTLY ENCOURAGING AFTER A MISTAKE. Think a trusted adult friend quietly saying 'take your time; try again.' Not congratulating, not disappointed, not pitying.
Make a COORDINATED visual change from welcoming:
Face turns toward viewer and inclines just a few degrees the opposite way to the welcoming reference, chin slightly lowered in a gentle acknowledging nod. Both eyes look calmly straight at viewer with relaxed upper eyelids, keeping substantial white areas. Eyebrows broad and relaxed with a subtle friendly asymmetric lift; no central worried peak or frown. Mouth is a SMALL CLOSED warm curved smile, NO teeth and NO open grin, no pursed lips. Shoulders are lowered and open; upper body leans slightly toward learner rather than tilting away.
Replace the greeting hand with one hand resting low at chest height, PALM UP in a quiet small 'we can try again' offering gesture, held horizontally, elbow relaxed. Hand clearly different from vertical wave. No thumbs-up, fist, clapping, raised arms, celebratory signs, sparkles, confetti, star, tear, blush, text, or icons. Keep whole hair and hand in frame, crop below chest. Character face scale same as supplied reference. Expression must read at 64px through gaze, smaller smile, nod and quiet posture together. Preserve all other design features and art style.

KEEP from image 1: appealing sculpted adult face, slightly angular jaw with small chin, warm confident expression, expressive thick eyebrows, SHAPED ALMOND EYES with cream-white sclera, plain dark brown irises and black pupils. Retain eyelid shape but remove separate eyelashes, eyeliner, iris reflections, gloss, makeup and realism. Small simple softly shaped mouth with just a sliver of teeth, NOT a broad grin. A characteristic long rounded-end hooked nose in just two lines. Dark curly shoulder-length hair with the signature off-center forehead curl.
KEEP from image 2: strong simple silhouette, graphic flat color areas, clean green overshirt over cream T-shirt, small gold stud earrings, spacious ivory background, simpler hands, efficient outlines, adult neck/shoulder construction.
INTERMEDIATE DETAIL: Hair uses 8–10 large interlocking wave clumps and at most 5 interior curved lines, NOT individual strands and NOT a featureless scalloped blob. Skin flat warm olive-brown with ONLY one hard-edged warm shadow shape under chin; no gradient cheeks, highlights, airbrushing, texture, grain, 3D or glossy surfaces. ONE additional darker green flat shadow plane on clothing, only 3–4 intentional garment folds. Spare lively charcoal contours with slight variation in weight. Eyes larger/clearer than realistic but smaller and less circular than image 2. Face has character rather than generic princess prettiness. Strong visual clarity at 64–96px.
STATE WELCOMING: directly meet viewer, brows gently lifted, head only slightly inclined, modest open smile with a little upper tooth, shoulders open, one small relaxed hand held vertically beside chest in hello (four distinct fingers plus thumb, human anatomy). Crop at lower chest, face around 42% of image height, full hair and hand within frame with ivory margin. Palette rich green #08734E, charcoal #292522, warm olive/terracotta skin, gold stud, small muted red mouth interior. Plain flat ivory #FAF7EF background. No text, props, icons, confetti, borders or watermark.
coffee:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished LANDSCAPE 3:2 lesson scene for adult language learning. Reference is the selected least-detailed Fattoush portrait. Preserve EXACT simplified Fattoush character identity and shape language: broad black-brown shoulder-length wavy hair formed by a handful of big rounded scallops, big front swooping lock on same side, long adult face, large white oval eyes with plain solid dark pupils, chunky eyebrows, simple long hooked nose, warm olive/terracotta skin, gold studs, rich deep green collared overshirt over cream top. No extra facial realism or strands. Flat broad color masses with spare dark contour, confident intentional shapes, no gradients, no texture, no gloss, no 3D. Warm ivory ground, forest green #08734E, rich muted red #B83F32, ochre gold #D9A42D, charcoal #292522. Adult proportions, friendly restrained acting, no huge smiles. Culturally grounded in an ordinary contemporary Levantine social setting through warm everyday interaction, never costumes, flags, religious symbols or tourist props. No writing, Arabic, words, speech bubbles, stickers, logos or watermark. Balanced generous negative space, minimal background; foreground people occupy majority of the scene. A second unnamed adult scene partner is incidental, NOT an approved Knafeh design. Same partner across both scenes: warm brown-skinned adult man with short dark curly crop, broad nose, short simple dark beard, muted red crewneck sweater, cream trousers. Clearly different silhouette to Fattoush.
SCENE: CATCHING UP OVER COFFEE. Two friends sitting opposite each other at a small round warm gold café table, simple cream ceramic coffee cups on saucers. Fattoush on LEFT, leaning forward attentively, head inclined toward her friend on right, CLOSED small smile and pupils focused on friend; one hand lightly around her cup, other relaxed on table. Friend on RIGHT speaking with small open smile and one low conversational palm-up gesture. Bodies and eye lines clearly interact. Their hands do not touch. Simple wood chairs, one olive-green plant in background, a quiet warm stone-colored wall and minimal curved window opening hint at ordinary neighborhood café. No ornate motifs or place-name cues. Clean adult convivial composition with entire heads inside frame, no awkward furniture crop. At most 2 background props.
